clips.title: The story
paras: Lorgus Jett is a human member of the Twilight's Hammer cult operating within the flooded corridors of Blackfathom Deeps. Wandering the Moonshrine Ruins, he serves as a ruthless commander in the cult's service to the Old Gods. Horde leaders have singled him out as a primary target to disrupt the cult's encroaching presence along the Ashenvale coast.

While many members of the Twilight's Hammer working under Blackfathom Deeps hail from orcish or tauren lineages, Lorgus Jett stands out as a human in the deep recesses of ancient night elf ruins. Roaming anywhere between the upper Moonshrine Ruins and the cavernous tunnels beyond the murloc defiler Gelihast, Jett coordinates the cult's dark rituals and violent ambitions.
